title: Registers touched by a base instruction
statement: Let $W$ be a word width, let $m$ be a memory assigning a $W$-bit word to each integer address, and let $i$ be a base instruction. The set of addresses it touches consists of the written or read register addresses; for an indirect load it also includes the address stored in the source register, and for an indirect store it also includes the address stored in the destination register. Accept and reject instructions touch no addresses.
